title: Crispy Canadian Stir Fried Broccoli
description: A quick and easy stir fry recipe featuring crispy Canadian bacon and fresh broccoli.
instructions: Heat the stir-fry oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the Canadian bacon and cook until crispy, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the broccoli and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the jazzy soy sauce and crisp red pepper flakes.
Pour the sauce over the broccoli and Canadian bacon, and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
